NAHHAS:v4p249/r16.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p249/r16.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p249/r16.claim: ذكّر means admonish them; الذكرى and الذكر are one, so the verb may be masculine or feminine.
NAHHAS:v4p249/r16.anchor: أي عظهم ( فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين ) ويجوز ينفع لأن الذكرى والذكر واحد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p182/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p182/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p182/r4.claim: Reminding benefits believers and those destined to join them later; on this interpretation the verse is not abrogated.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p182/r4.anchor: وذكر فقط، فإن الذكرى نافعة للمؤمنين ولمن قضي له أن يكون منهم

QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r20.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r20.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r20.claim: Qatadah says to remind through the Qur'an because believers benefit from its admonition.
QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r20.anchor: قتادة: «وذكر» بالقرآن { فإن الذكرى } به { تنفع المؤمنين }.

QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r21.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r21.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r21.claim: Another view says to remind people of punishment and God's days; believers are specified because they benefit.
QURTUBI-FULL:51:50-55/r21.anchor: وقيل: ذكرهم بالعقوبة وأيام الله. وخص المؤمنين لأنهم المنتفعون بها.

ZAJJAJ:v5p58/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p58/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p58/r3.claim: The reminder should recall God's days, punishment, retribution, and mercy.
ZAJJAJ:v5p58/r3.anchor: أي ذكرهم بأيام الله وعذابه وعقابه ورحمته

TABATABAI:51:52-56/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:51:52-56/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:51:52-56/r6.claim: The command to remind follows the command to turn away: continue admonishing, since it benefits believers, unlike disputation with rebels which only increases their transgression and disbelief.
TABATABAI:51:52-56/r6.anchor: تفريع على الأمر بالتولي عنهم فهو أمر بالتذكير بعد النهي عن الجدال معهم، والمعنى واستمر على التذكير والعظة فذكر كما

TABRISI:51:52-57/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:51:52-57/r6.speaker: الكلبي
TABRISI:51:52-57/r6.claim: Al-Kalbī says the reminder that benefits believers means admonishing those who believe with the Qurʾan.
TABRISI:51:52-57/r6.anchor: ومعناه عظ بالقرآن من آمن من قولك فإن الذكرى تنفعهم عن الكلبي

ELMALILI:51:47-60#2/r19.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:51:47-60#2/r19.speaker: author
ELMALILI:51:47-60#2/r19.claim: The Prophet must continue reminding people because it benefits believers by renewing memory and faith, preventing heedlessness, increasing joy, teaching the uninformed, and sometimes bringing people to faith.
ELMALILI:51:47-60#2/r19.anchor: İman etmiş olanların unutmamasına, gaflete düşmemesine, imanlarının kuvvetlenmesine

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:51:52/r10.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:51:52/r10.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:51:52/r10.claim: Reminders strengthen believers' faith and conduct and can bring receptive people to faith and believer-like conduct; Zamakhshari calls them those God knows will believe.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:51:52/r10.anchor: Öğüt, iman sahiplerinin imanlarının güçlenmesine ve daha güzel davranmalarına; imana yatkınlığı olanların yani gözlerini, kulaklarını, gönüllerini hakikat çağrısına kapatmayanların da iman etmelerine

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p515/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p515/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p515/r2.claim: Every nation treated its messenger similarly, so the Prophet should patiently continue, turn from wrongdoers, and remind those who respond; God will support him and his companions.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p515/r2.anchor: the same attitude was adopted by every nation towards their respective messengers

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r1.claim: Although the Prophet should ignore the rebellious leaders, he must keep guiding those willing to listen; reminders benefit people seeking faith.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r1.anchor: he should continue to guide those who are ready to listen to him. The seekers of faith benefit from his reminders and instruction

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r2.claim: The order to ignore applies to conceited Quraysh leaders unwilling to listen; the Prophet had pursued them because their conversion might strengthen the new faith and bring others to it.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r2.anchor: the directive of ignoring people relates to the rebellious leaders of the Quraysh who because of conceit were not prepared to listen to anything

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r3.claim: After the truth had been conclusively conveyed and the leaders proved immovable, God stopped the Prophet from spending more time pursuing them.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p520/r3.anchor: when the truth had been conclusively conveyed to them, and it became evident that these rocks will not budge from their place

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r2.claim: Reminding benefits believers and those God will guide; the apparent truce is abrogated by the sword verse.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r2.anchor: وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين: تؤثر فيهم وفيمن قدر الله أن يؤمن،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r3.speaker: علي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r3.claim: He reports Muslims were saddened by the command to turn away, fearing revelation had ended; the following command to remind reassured them.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p561/r3.anchor: وعن علي، كرم الله وجهه: لما نزل فتول عنهم، حزن المسلمون

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r4.speaker: المفسرون
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r4.claim: The exegetes say the command to turn away saddened the Prophet and distressed his Companions, who feared revelation had ceased and punishment was near; the command to remind them then reassured them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r4.anchor: المفسرون: لما نزلت هذه الآية حزن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم واشتد ذلك على أصحابه، وظنوا أن الوحي قد انقطع،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r5.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r5.claim: Muqatil says to admonish Meccan disbelievers with the Qur'an; reminders benefit those God already knew would believe.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r5.anchor: قال مقاتل: معناه عظ بالقرآن كفار مكة، فإن الذكرى تنفع من [سبق]

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r6.speaker: الكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r6.claim: Al-Kalbi says to remind the believers among the Prophet's people, since reminders benefit them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p380/r6.anchor: وقال الكلبي: عظ بالقرآن من آمن من قومك فإن الذكرى تنفعهم.

BIQAI-FULL:v7p287/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p287/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p287/r6.claim: He should continue reminding gently because admonition benefits believers, who need repeated warnings to overcome desire and forgetfulness.

BIQAI-FULL:v7p287/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p287/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p287/r7.claim: Believers are those God has destined to be deeply rooted in faith; repeated reminders overcome their competing interests and appetites.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p287/r7.anchor: ولا بد من إكثار التذكير ليلغلب ما عندهم من نوازع الحظوظ

BIQAI-FULL:v7p271#2/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p271#2/r7.speaker: أبو جعفر بن الزبير
BIQAI-FULL:v7p271#2/r7.claim: The Prophet’s reward lies in reminding and calling people to God; the reminder benefits believers, and those destined for felicity respond to it.

ASAD-NOTES:51:54/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:51:54/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:51:54/r2.claim: He should continue reminding people, since reminders benefit believers.
ASAD-NOTES:51:54/r2.anchor: for, verily, such a reminder will profit the believers

ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r1.claim: The imperative means persist in reminder and admonition; it is treated as intransitive, though an understood object “them” may be supplied.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r1.anchor: آدم على فعل التذكير والموعظة ولا تدع ذلك فالأمر بالتذكير للدوام

ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r2.claim: The object may instead be omitted because it is obvious: remind them.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r3.claim: “The believers” may mean those God has destined to believe or those already believing; reminder increases their insight and certainty.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r3.anchor: المؤمنين بالفعل فإنها تزيذهم بصيرة وقوة في اليقين

ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r4.speaker: البحر
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r4.claim: Al-Bahr says the verse's apparent call for a truce was abrogated by the sword verse.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r4.anchor: يدل ظاهر الآية على الموادعة وهي منسوخة بآية السيف

ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas says God ordered Muhammad to withdraw so rejecters would be punished and excused him; the subsequent command to remind abrogated the withdrawal order.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r5.anchor: أمره الله تعالى أن يتولى عنهم ليعذبهم وعذر محمدا صلى الله عليه وسلم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r6.speaker: علي
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r6.claim: Ali says that when “turn away, you are not blamed” was revealed, believers feared destruction was certain; “and remind” then reassured them.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r6.anchor: من طريق مجاهد عن علي كرم الله تعالى وجهه قال : لما نزلت

ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r7.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r7.claim: Qatada says believers thought revelation had ceased and punishment had arrived, until God revealed the command to remind.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p20#2/r7.anchor: وعن قتادة أنهم ظنوا أن الوحي قد انقطع وأن العذاب قد حضر

BAYDAWI-FULL:51:55-58/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:51:55-58/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:51:55-58/r1.claim: Do not abandon admonition: it benefits those destined to believe or believers by increasing their insight.
BAYDAWI-FULL:51:55-58/r1.anchor: ولا تدع التذكير والموعظة. { فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين }

DURR-FULL:v7p624/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r3.speaker: علي
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r3.claim: Ali glosses the reminder as the Quran.
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r3.anchor: حتى نزلت {وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين} قال: ذكر بالقرآن

DURR-FULL:v7p624/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r4.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r4.claim: Mujahid says the Prophet was first told to turn away from them, then to admonish them because reminders benefit believers.
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r4.anchor: عن مجاهد رضي الله عنه في قوله {فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم} قال: فأعرض عنهم فقيل له: {وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين} فوعظهم

DURR-FULL:v7p624/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r5.speaker: سلمان بن حبيب المحاربي
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r5.claim: Salman ibn Habib says that whoever feels the reminder take effect in his heart should know he is a believer.
DURR-FULL:v7p624/r5.anchor: عن سلمان بن حبيب المحاربي قال: من وجد للذكرى في قلبه موقعا فليعلم أنه مؤمن قال الله

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p42#4/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p42#4/r2.speaker: مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p42#4/r2.anchor: وفي قوله وذكر قولان أحدهما عظ قاله مقاتل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p42#4/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p42#4/r3.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p42#4/r3.claim: Al-Zajjaj says to remind them of God's days, including His punishment and mercy.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p42#4/r3.anchor: والثاني ذكرهم بأيام الله وعذابه ورحمته قاله الزجاج

BURSEVI:v9p142/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p142/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p142/r10.claim: The command means to continue reminders and admonition, not abandon them altogether; the implied object pronoun is omitted because it is evident.
BURSEVI:v9p142/r10.anchor: أي افعل التذكير والموعظة ولا تعدهما بالكلية

BURSEVI:v9p142/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p142/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p142/r11.claim: Alternatively, the command means 'remind them'; the object pronoun is omitted because the context makes it clear.
BURSEVI:v9p142/r11.anchor: أو فذكرهم وقد حذف الضمير لظهور الأمر

BURSEVI:v9p142/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p142/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p142/r12.claim: Believers are either those whose faith God has decreed or those who have already believed; reminders increase their insight and certainty, and admonition softens hard hearts.
BURSEVI:v9p142/r12.anchor: أي الذين قدر الله إيمانهم أو الذين آمنوا بالفعل

BURSEVI:v9p142/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p142/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p142/r13.claim: Believers should keep receiving instruction despite the unbelievers' obstinacy, since counsel has many benefits and softens hard hearts.
BURSEVI:v9p142/r13.anchor: فإنها تزيدهم بصيرة وقوة في اليقين

BURSEVI:v9p142/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p142/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p142/r14.claim: A cited hadith says every believer repeatedly falls into a familiar sin, since believers are forgetful and tested, but remember when reminded.
BURSEVI:v9p142/r14.anchor: ما من مؤمن إلا وله ذنب قد اعتاده الفينة بعد الفينة

BURSEVI:v9p142/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p142/r15.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v9p142/r15.claim: For the obedient, a reminder is news of abundant reward; for gnostics, it recalls the afflictions God has spared them.
BURSEVI:v9p142/r15.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ذكر المطيعين جزيل ثوابي وذكر العارفين

BURSEVI:v9p142/r16.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p142/r16.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v9p142/r16.claim: A further Sufi gloss says reminders warn sinners of punishment so they return, encourage the obedient with reward, and renew lovers' witnessing of divine beauty and majesty.
BURSEVI:v9p142/r16.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ذكر العاصين منهم عقوبتي ليرجعوا عن مخالفة أمري

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r1.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r1.claim: Qatāda says to remind people through the Qur’an.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r2.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r2.claim: Mujāhid says to exhort, since exhortation benefits believers.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r2.anchor: فذكر بالعظة فإن الوعظ ينفع المؤمنين , قاله مجاهد

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r3.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r3.claim: Reminder of reward and punishment benefits believers through hope and fear.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p374/r3.anchor: وذكر بالثواب والعقاب فإن الرغبة والرهبة تنفع المؤمنين

MUQATIL:51:54-55/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:51:54-55/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:51:54-55/r3.claim: The Prophet is told to keep reminding, since reminders benefit believers.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p181#11/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p181#11/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p181#11/r2.claim: The reminder benefits believers by increasing their deeds.

STUDYQURAN:51:55/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r1.claim: The command to remind may address believers alone or both believers and disbelievers.
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r1.anchor: Remind is aimed at either the believers to the exclusion of the disbelievers or both the believers and the disbelievers

STUDYQURAN:51:55/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r2.claim: The Reminder here refers to the Quran.
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r2.anchor: Here the Reminder is understood as a reference to the Quran

STUDYQURAN:51:55/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r3.claim: The verse enjoins Quran preaching, which benefits believers with deeper spiritual insight and greater certainty and knowledge.
STUDYQURAN:51:55/r3.anchor: it benefits believers by increasing their spiritual insight

TAB-FULL:v21p551/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p551/r9.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v21p551/r9.claim: Qatada says the companions feared revelation had ceased and punishment was imminent when told to withdraw; the following command to remind them then came.
TAB-FULL:v21p551/r9.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم} [الذاريات: 54] " ذكر لنا أنها لما نزلت هذه الآية، اشتد على أصحاب رسول الله

TAB-FULL:v21p551/r10.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p551/r10.speaker: علي
TAB-FULL:v21p551/r10.claim: Ali relates that the companions were saddened and thought the Messenger had been ordered to leave them until the reminder command was revealed.
TAB-FULL:v21p551/r10.anchor: عن مجاهد قال: خرج علي معتجرا ببرد، مشتملا بخميصة، فقال " لما نزلت {فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم} [الذاريات: 54] أحزننا ذلك وقلنا

TAB-FULL:v21p553/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p553/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v21p553/r1.claim: Muhammad is to admonish those to whom he was sent, since admonition benefits people who believe in God.
TAB-FULL:v21p553/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد، {وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين} [الذاريات: 55] قال: «وعظهم»

TAB-FULL:v21p553/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p553/r2.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v21p553/r2.claim: Mujahid glosses the command as admonish them.
TAB-FULL:v21p553/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد، {وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين} [الذاريات: 55] قال: «وعظهم»

SULAMI:v2p278/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p278/r1.speaker: جعفر الصادق
SULAMI:v2p278/r1.claim: Ja'far al-Sadiq says Muhammad should remind servants of God's generosity and favors, and of primordial care that preceded faith, knowledge, certainty, obedience, and protection from sin.
SULAMI:v2p278/r1.anchor: قال جعفر الصادق : يعني يا محمد ذكر عبادي جودي وكرمي وآلائي ونعمي وما سبق من العناية القديمة

SULAMI:v2p278/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p278/r2.speaker: جعفر
SULAMI:v2p278/r2.claim: Ja'far distinguishes human forgetfulness from God, who cannot be subject to ignorance or forgetting; when a person remembers God, God remembers that person.
SULAMI:v2p278/r2.anchor: قال جعفر : كل من ذكر الله فإن نسي ذكره كان مجهولا عن ذكره والله تعالى ذكره احديته وأزليته

SULAMI:v2p278/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p278/r3.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p278/r3.claim: Ibn Ata distinguishes admonition for ordinary people, counsel for companions, and reminder for the elect; reminding is required of discerning believers lest Sunna and obligations lapse.
SULAMI:v2p278/r3.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : الذكرى لموعظة والموعظة للعوام والنصيحة للإخوان والتذكرة للخواص فرض افترضه الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the Prophet feared punishment would descend on his people; Muqatil and Qatada agree, and the Companions feared revelation had stopped and punishment was imminent before the command to remind came.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس: فحزن رسول الله -صلى الله عليه وسلم- لما نزلت هذه الآية مخافة أن تنزل بقومه العذاب.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r3.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r3.claim: Al-Kalbi says the Prophet is commanded to turn from unbelievers and admonish the believers, since the reminder benefits those who believe.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r3.anchor: قال الكلبي: عظ بالقرآن من آمن من قومك، فإن الذكرى تنفعهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r4.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r4.claim: Muqatil instead takes the command as warning Mecca's unbelievers with the Quran; the reminder benefits those destined to believe, and al-Wahidi says this better fits the preceding verse.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p464#2/r4.anchor: وهو قول مقاتل. يقول: عظ كفار مكة بوعيد القرآن، فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين

BURHAN:v2p137/r10.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p137/r10.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p137/r10.claim: The call’s phrase that prayer is better than sleep is associated with the reminder that benefits believers and with the warning not to turn away while hearing.
BURHAN:v2p137/r10.anchor: وقوله الصلاة خير من النوم قى قوله
